sentences.text: Kenneth Lonergan -LRB- born October 16 , 1962 -RRB- is an American playwright , screenwriter , and director .

He is best known for writing Gangs of New York -LRB- 2002 -RRB- and for writing and directing Manchester by the Sea -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	Gangs of New York	Gangs of New York	Manchester by the Sea	Manchester by the Sea (film)

He earned an Academy Award for Best Director nomination for Manchester by the Sea , and was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay for You Can Count on Me , Gangs of New York and Manchester by the Sea , winning the Oscar for the last at the 89th Academy Awards .
